mentions.name: IQ Test Platform
mentions.description: A professional, modern, proprietary IQ test and testing platform that lets individuals test themselves and lets professionals administer IQ tests to others. It is used by Silicon Valley startups for hiring and was built mainly for intelligence researchers from ISIR and psychologists.
mentions.source_excerpt: IQ Test Platform (https://www.riotiq.com) I've been working 3 years on this. We developed our own professional, modern, proprietary IQ test and IQ testing platform for individuals to test themselves and to administer professional IQ tests to others. Lots of silicon valley folks seem to love it for their startups and hiring, but we built it mainly for IQ researchers from the International Society For Intelligence Research (ISIR) and psychologists.
